{{Quote|The leader of the Sligo Pirate gang is going to race the Twi'lek!|[[Oollie]]|<ref name="AA" />}}
Sometime after [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]], the '''leader''' of the [[Sligo Pirate gang]] challenged a [[Unidentified Twi'lek racer|Twi'lek]] to a [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop race]] in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]]. [[Gender/Legends|He]] lost the race, so his gang left, needing to choose a new leader.<ref name="AA" />
